name: opentyrian
title: OpenTyrian (C, SDL2)
_doc: A REIMPLEMENTATION, like OpenDUNE -- so it says PRISM handles a large modern-C program, not that it runs unmodified 1990s source. What makes it worth the trip is its DATA: Tyrian 2.1 was released as freeware by its author, so unlike Dune II there is nothing to own.
_state: Renders its title menu: 640x400, 202,143 non-black pixels of 256,000. Stops at JE_main, which is one of the six functions tier-0 still cannot emit -- two declarations of the same name in sibling blocks, in a function that needs control-flow flattening.
_units: The makefile is one line: SRCS := $(wildcard src/*.c). No subdirectories.
_data: Tyrian 2.1, released as FREEWARE by its author -- tyrian21.zip, 4,754,048 bytes, 106 files, from camanis.net/tyrian. Like every target, read from a directory the user names and never in the repository.
